faqs.question: Where is the Pak Clay shop in Islamabad?
faqs.answer: G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad. Call +92 300 4617715 before you leave so we can guide you inside the housing scheme.

faqs.question: How much do terracotta tiles cost in Islamabad?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on size, shape, thickness, finish, quantity, season and delivery distance. Ask for a written quote stating the unit, inclusions and date.

faqs.question: Is a clay maker different from a general tiles shop in Islamabad?
faqs.answer: A general dealer carries many materials and brands, while a clay maker can explain the clay, firing and fixing in depth. Many buyers compare both.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to Islamabad and Rawalpindi?
faqs.answer: Delivery depends on the order, product and location, so we confirm it case by case. Send your area and quantity on WhatsApp for an answer.

faqs.question: How do I get a free sample in Islamabad?
faqs.answer: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with your area, use and city, or visit the Civic Center location. Samples are free.
